historical_replay_validation.contract: Operation-specific map-reduction and summary bounds. Primary estimates, percentile intervals, labels, counts, missingness, ties, preferences and decisions match exactly. Optional BCa/t endpoints use an independently checked post hoc accuracy contract: outward 90-decimal interval arithmetic with pointwise 16u normal CDF and 8u inverse-CDF/power checks, u=2^-53. This is not a registered inference criterion, a universal library guarantee, or certification of unpreserved historical intermediates.
